rules.title: Repeated failed AI sign-ins
rules.description: Detect repeated failures for the same exact actor and AI application.
rules.grouping: actor external_uid (casefold) + application asset id; densest sliding window wins
rules.evidenceSemantics: Groups by exact actor/application identity only; activities missing either side count as incomplete, not as misses.

rules.title: High-impact AI app consent grant
rules.description: Detect successful consent changes for exact, active, unreviewed AI apps.
rules.evidenceSemantics: Proves the consent operation and scope only; feeds the consent-then-use issue rule.

rules.title: Unreviewed model invocation
rules.description: Detect successful invocation of an exact model still awaiting governance review.
rules.evidenceSemantics: Requires exact model identity matched to inventory; unresolved model references stay unresolved, never invented.

rules.title: AWS undeclared model invocation
rules.description: Detect an exact AWS model used by an agent without declared evidence.
rules.evidenceSemantics: Session-scoped agent attribution; a model with no declared evidence is flagged, not auto-registered.

rules.title: AWS unapproved tool invocation
rules.description: Detect observed AWS tool execution that is not explicitly approved.
rules.evidenceSemantics: Approval is explicit allow-list evidence; absence of approval is the finding, not proof of malice.

rules.title: AWS risky action sequence
rules.description: Detect a retrieval followed by a mutation-like tool call in one AWS session.
rules.evidenceSemantics: Order + session + 5-minute window prove sequence only; intent is never inferred.

rules.title: Agent sensitive-data write path
rules.description: Correlate independently supported agent-to-sensitive-data write paths.
rules.evidenceSemantics: Finding references select already-observed assets by kind + exact natural key — they never add nodes or edges. Only observed/externally-verified capability relationships at >=0.8 confidence participate.

rules.title: Unreviewed AI consent then use
rules.description: Correlate high-impact consent with later exact use of the same AI app.
rules.evidenceSemantics: Proves sequence and identity only. Does not claim the application exercised the granted permission or that either observed actor had malicious intent.

rules.title: Deployed Bedrock governance gap
rules.description: Correlate an included unguarded Bedrock call with broad runtime authority.
rules.evidenceSemantics: The deployment join and reachable-source set prove artifact inclusion only; workload config + role identity independently prove runtime context. Does not claim the source call was executed.
